title: Business English Conversation 50:  Having a Chat
content: 1. to be (time) early: to arrive (time) before the scheduled time - We were 20 minutes early. - He was an hour early for his job interview. 2. to find a seat: to get a chair or place to sit down - Let's find a seat. - I will find a couple of seats for us at the front. Call me when you get here. 3. I bet...: I'm pretty sure that... - I bet that the stock price will go up next week. - I bet that she will be fired next week.
